purpose: Issue #59 stages 1-3: immutable upstream and canonical unified-v3 contract gate before any adapter implementation.

resolved_constraints.writable_remote_or_fork: Resolved: origin is the writable kh11kim/hgc_net fork and upstream is the official yimingli1998/hgc_net repository.
resolved_constraints.upstream_license: User-directed non-blocker for this work. This records no license conclusion and makes no distribution claim.

stage4_decisions.gripper_output_boundary: Change the hand-specific output boundary from the upstream DLR hand to Justin-right. Do not retain a 20-to-12 joint adapter.
stage4_decisions.positive_surface_point_matching: Use each canonical positive grasp's approach_point as the point used to match that grasp to the visible surface point cloud.

point_count_context.sample: 100-view stride sample after depth deprojection and 0.5 m reconstruction-grid crop

point_sampling_policy.at_or_above_fixed_input_count: Deterministically sample 25,000 distinct points without replacement.
point_sampling_policy.below_fixed_input_count: Deterministically keep every visible point and repeat deterministically selected existing points only for the shortfall to 25,000.

sparse_point_supervision.positive: For each view-visible canonical positive, use approach_point and label its sampled visible 5 mm neighborhood.
sparse_point_supervision.negative: Use a deterministic 10% of remaining visible sampled points as negatives; all other point/template pairs are ignore.
sparse_point_supervision.canonical_negative_payload: negative_palm_pose9d and negative_q_contact have no negative approach_point, so they are not converted into invented point labels.

justin_pose_and_joint_boundary.grasp_type_idx_order: Verified against the Justin KMK grasp_templates insertion order.
justin_pose_and_joint_boundary.joint_targets: Native 12-DoF q_contact and q_squeeze in canonical physical radians; q_open is static KMK template data, not predicted.
justin_pose_and_joint_boundary.depth_bin_adapter: Preserve upstream bin/residual pose representation and angular bins, but replace the DLR-specific depth_cm-20 in [0,8) with direct approach-point-to-palm centimetres in [0,29). A full 8,995-view train scan found 1,767,876 visible positives, 100 targets at or above 28 cm, none at or above 29 cm, and a 28.4019 cm maximum.

post_processing.top_side_filter: Apply the physical meaning of upstream R[:,2,2]>0, not the raw matrix index: keep candidates whose palm lies on the +world-z side of the grasp point (a top-side approach). Canonical reconstruction-grid z is world-up. Implement it as an explicit dot product with world-up after a fixture verifies the approach-axis sign.
post_processing.nms: Apply the exact aggressive upstream 3 cm / 30 degree NMS and log candidate counts before and after it. Suppress a lower-scored candidate when either its position is within 3 cm of a kept candidate or its rotation differs by at most 30 degrees; retain it only when both are farther/different. Fixture-test it in the canonical frame.

context_only.meaning: This is a separate paper-modified 3D-FPN HGC lineage. It is context only, not an upstream parity source or an implementation target for stages 1-3.
